credit.credit-words: Oh, Give Me Rest from Self
WORDS: Eliza H. Hamilton, pub.1869. MUSIC: “O Give Me Rest”; Handley C. G. Moule, pub.1898. Public Domain.

He that is entered into his rest, he also hath ceased from his own works.... Let us labour therefore to enter into that rest. Heb. 4:4-11 Lord, thou wilt ordain peace for us: for thou also hast wrought all our works in us. Isa. 26:12; 30:15-29; Psa 17
